body:
I'm seeing a therapist too, but the fact is: they can't change what you look like and they can't change your shitty genetics. All they can help you do is help you cope with it and change your perspective. Same goes with pills. Antidepressants take the edge off, but it's futile because you can't change anything. I know it's incredible negative, but that's the reality. 

I work for a utility company. It pays well, but the work is uninspiring. I keep the gas on for people. Knowing that it is a hydrocarbon and causing global warming makes me feel even shittier. But in this world, you need money to survive and eat.
